title: Automatic background color detection for non-fullscreen wallpapers
line: Image, Slideshow and Picture of the Day wallpapers can now fill the space around a picture that doesn't cover the screen with the picture's own edge color.
explanation: With "Scaled, keep proportions" or "Centered", a wallpaper that doesn't match the screen's shape leaves bars that could only be blurred or filled with one fixed color, which rarely suits every picture (especially Picture of the Day, which changes daily). Picture of the Day also always showed its color setting, even for fill modes that cover the whole screen. The Image and Slideshow wallpapers get a third Background choice, "Matching color": TransientImage now also averages the strips of the image next to the bars while it loads (no extra decode), and the background uses that color, blended for day/night wallpapers. Picture of the Day gets the same choice through a small EdgeColorSampler, and its background row is now only shown for the two fill modes that leave empty space.

commits.message:
wallpapers/image: add a matching color background option

When a wallpaper doesn't fill the screen, the empty area around it could
only be blurred or filled with one fixed color. A new "Matching color"
option fills it with the average color of the image's bordering edges.

BUG: 431735

wallpapers/potd: add a matching color background option

Picture of the Day always showed the background color setting, even when
the image fills the screen. It now only appears when the image leaves an
empty area, and can follow the color of the image's bordering edges.

BUG: 431735
